text: In 0222 K4's readings at key lengths 27-29 scored 8 out of 100 with the judge, every copy 7 or less. Luck is tested by more copies.
Fresh scrambles through 0034's frozen search at 27-29, judged in batches of eight; 80 in a row below 8 would be a flag.

Copy 6 of the first batch scored 8: not a flag; A6.1's cell closes. Recorded as kept by mistake: gate 4 was given only the 8 fresh copies, and a K4 reading that fails against its own search's copies passed (issue #94); 0225 reruns it.
